pairs: Petrus autem et Joannes ascendebant in templum ad horam orationis nonam.
Now Peter and John went up to the temple at the ninth hour of prayer.
qui erat claudus ex utero matris suæ,
who was lame from his mother’s womb,
quem ponebant quotidie ad portam templi,
They would lay him every day at the gate of the temple,
ut peteret eleemosynam ab introëuntibus in templum.
so that he might request alms from those entering into the temple.
Is cum vidisset Petrum et Joannem incipientes introire in templum,
And this man, when he had seen Peter and John beginning to enter the temple,
was begging, so that he might receive alms.
Intuens autem in eum Petrus cum Joanne,
Then Peter and John, gazing at him,
And he looked intently at them,
sperans se aliquid accepturum ab eis.
hoping that he might receive something from them.
Argentum et aurum non est mihi:
in nomine Jesu Christi Nazareni surge,
In the name of Jesus Christ the Nazarene,
And taking him by the right hand,
et protinus consolidatæ sunt bases ejus et plantæ.
And immediately his legs and feet were strengthened.
And leaping up, he stood and walked around.
et intravit cum illis in templum ambulans,
And he entered with them into the temple,
walking and leaping and praising God.
Et vidit omnis populus eum ambulantem et laudantem Deum.
And all the people saw him walking and praising God.
quod ipse erat qui ad eleemosynam sedebat ad Speciosam portam templi:
that he was the same one who was sitting for alms at the Beautiful Gate of the temple.
et impleti sunt stupore et extasi in eo quod contigerat illi.
And they were filled with awe and amazement at what had happened to him.
Cum teneret autem Petrum et Joannem,
Then, as he held on to Peter and John,
cucurrit omnis populus ad eos ad porticum quæ appellatur Salomonis,
all the people ran to them at the portico, which is called Solomon’s,
why do you wonder at this?
Or why do you stare at us,
as if it were by our own strength or power that we caused this man to walk?
The God of Abraham and the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob,
Deus patrum nostrorum glorificavit filium suum Jesum,
handed over and denied before the face of Pilate,
when he was giving judgment to release him.
Vos autem sanctum et justum negastis,
Then you denied the Holy and Just One,
et petistis virum homicidam donari vobis:
and petitioned for a murderous man to be given to you.
Truly, it was the Author of Life whom you put to death,
whom God raised from the dead,
And by faith in his name,
hunc quem vos vidistis et nostis,
dedit integram sanitatem istam in conspectu omnium vestrum.
And faith through him has given this man complete health in the sight of you all.
I know that you did this through ignorance,
just as your leaders also did.
Deus autem, quæ prænuntiavit per os omnium prophetarum, pati Christum suum,
But in this way God has fulfilled the things that he announced beforehand through the mouth of all the Prophets:
so that your sins may be wiped away.
ut cum venerint tempora refrigerii a conspectu Domini,
And then, when the time of consolation will have arrived from the presence of the Lord,
et miserit eum qui prædicatus est vobis,
he will send the One who was foretold to you,
quem oportet quidem cælum suscipere usque in tempora restitutionis omnium quæ locutus est Deus per os sanctorum suorum a sæculo prophetarum.
whom heaven certainly must take up, until the time of the restoration of all things, which God has spoken of by the mouth of his holy prophets, from ages past.
Quoniam prophetam suscitabit vobis Dominus Deus vester de fratribus vestris,
‘For the Lord your God shall raise up a Prophet for you from your brothers, one like me;
tamquam me: ipsum audietis juxta omnia quæcumque locutus fuerit vobis.
the same shall you listen to according to everything whatsoever that he shall speak to you.
omnis anima quæ non audierit prophetam illum, exterminabitur de plebe.
every soul who will not listen to that Prophet shall be exterminated from the people.’
And all the prophets who have spoken,
You are sons of the prophets
et testamenti quod disposuit Deus ad patres nostros,
and of the testament which God has appointed for our fathers,
Et in semine tuo benedicentur omnes familiæ terræ.
‘And by your offspring all the families of the earth shall be blessed.’
Vobis primum Deus suscitans filium suum,
God raised up his Son and sent him first to you,
ut convertat se unusquisque a nequitia sua.
so that each one may turn himself away from his wickedness.”
